def ComplexMultiply_forward(X_re, X_im, Y_re, Y_im):
    Z_re = torch.addcmul(X_re*Y_re, -1, X_im, Y_im)
    Z_im = torch.addcmul(X_re*Y_im,  1, X_im, Y_re)
